COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover. Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        useIcon
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Resolves a semantic icon name to a React node through the nearest Theme, so a custom component draws the same success, warning or error icon that Astryx components draw and follows a theme that overrides it.

name:        useInputContainer
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Makes an input container wrapper clickable, delegating focus to the inner input/textarea when the user clicks non-interactive areas (icons, padding, status indicators).

name:        useInputStatusIcon
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Builds the on-field status affordance for a bordered input and its accessibility wiring, so every input in the family behaves the same for a given status.
